title: Extend Rust number-utils in 2 steps: parity helpers then clamp
description: A Rust number-utilities library starts with only abs(). Grow it in two focused steps, each adding new functions and tests without breaking existing tests.

task_spec.prompt:
The Rust library in src/lib.rs currently exports only abs(n: i64) -> i64 with 3 passing tests. Extend it in two steps:

Step 1 — Parity helpers:
  pub fn is_even(n: i64) -> bool
  pub fn is_odd(n: i64) -> bool
  Add 4 tests: test_is_even_positive, test_is_even_negative, test_is_odd_basic, test_is_even_zero.
  All 3 existing abs tests must still pass.

Step 2 — Clamp:
  pub fn clamp(n: i64, min: i64, max: i64) -> i64
  Returns min if n < min, max if n > max, else n.
  Add 3 tests: test_clamp_below, test_clamp_above, test_clamp_within.
  All 7 tests from Step 1 must still pass.

cargo test must show 10 tests passing (3 original + 4 parity + 3 clamp). cargo build must succeed.
success_criteria: clamp handles below, above, and within range
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `cargo test` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `cargo test` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
